summary.text: Zack Stephenson is a Democratic state representative from Minnesota House District 35A who has served in the Minnesota House since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, he co-chairs the House Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Zack Stephenson was born in Minneapolis, lives in Coon Rapids, and graduated from Coon Rapids High School in 2002.
He earned a B.A. in public policy analysis from Knox College in 2006 and a J.D. from the University of Chicago in 2010.

His career experience includes working as an attorney in private practice and as an assistant county attorney in Hennepin County, and he served on the Coon Rapids Planning Commission from 2012 to 2018.
Ballotpedia lists Stephenson's tenure in the Minnesota House as beginning in 2019, and his current term ends on January 12, 2027.
He chaired the Commerce Finance and Policy Committee in the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Commerce Finance and Policy, Taxes, and Ways and Means committees, and he co-chairs the Ways and Means Committee.
